category.label: Category
category.none: No category yet: the test has not been passed or is still in progress.
category.assigned: Assigned on {date} by the adaptive test

skills.label: Skill profile
skills.note: The scale shows the level and its margin of error: the narrower the band, the more confident the estimate. “Confidently Middle” means the level is within the Middle band with a probability of at least {confidence} %; “between Middle and Senior” means there is not yet enough confidence for a single band.

fsp.empty: No FSP history: the skill profile is built from the platform test, with no penalty.
fsp.note: Results of in-person FSP competitions from the registry are the highest level of trust. Wins, prizes and finals count towards the skill profile; taking part in a qualifier is a fact, not a level estimate.

experience.note: Entries and years by technology are self-reported: they are not confirmed by the test or FSP and do not affect the level estimate. Years are counted from entry periods without double-counting overlaps, rounded down to half a year.
